description: Defines a template class 'BaseContainerAdministrator' managing container instances with thread safety, including methods for container retrieval, removal, and iteration.

classes.name: BaseContainerAdministrator
classes.description: A thread-safe template class managing a collection of container objects, providing methods to access, insert, and remove containers.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over container IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, increasing its reference count.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container from the internal list; called during container destruction.

methods.name: InternalLock
methods.description: Locks the internal mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: InsertContainer
methods.description: Adds a container to the internal list; must be called with lock held.
